response.overview: Francesco, a charming and ambitious separated father, picks up his son Mattia from school to spend "their" day together. He manages to transform a perfectly normal and seemingly quiet afternoon into a fun, special, and almost outlandish adventure. However, everything changes in the evening when Francesco drops Mattia off at his ex-wife's house and has to return to his everyday reality—and the bitterness of solitude.
response.title: La Casa di Papà
